research_direction: Does the size of the SFT stage's weight update govern the midtrain x SFT interaction? The midtrain factor is a single displacement vector in parameter space; SFT then moves both arms much further. This attempt shrinks the SFT displacement 4x (peak LR 5e-6 vs 2e-5), holding the midtrain checkpoints bit-identical and the SFT corpora byte-identical, and asks whether the interaction grows (limited by how much midtrain signal survives) or shrinks (limited by the SFT stage's own install).
submitted_cells: SFT seed 20260804, four cells trained at peak LR 5e-6 from the same two midtrain checkpoints used by PRs #291/#293/#297/#302.
relationship_to_prior_attempts: Same 2x2 skeleton, same eval spec and same item seed as #297/#302, so the two learning-rate levels are directly comparable. The standard-rate level is not retrained here -- it is the seven-seed grid already reported. What is new is a parameter-space measurement of the midtrain factor and a lever that moves it.

token_matching.note: Both midtrain arms are token-matched by construction (scimt.train.mix.control_mix). The SFT arms are token-matched to within the packing remainder; the exact totals are listed above rather than asserted.
